## Fixed

- Show loading and connection errors with a Retry button instead of an empty library.
- Preserve games, covers, and searches when refreshes fail; retain the last successful index after failed rescans.
- Correct the Traefik example to use port `8080`.

## Added

- Separate Edge prereleases and verified stable packages with Docker/source archives and checksums.

## Security

- Update Go and Alpine images and apply available OS security patches.
- Run containers as non-root UID/GID `10001:10001`; check collection read permissions before upgrading.
